title: Closing message when the verdict record is missing or unreadable
context: Issue #887 B1: the Stop hook holds the closing message once when it names a different verdict word than <root>/.paqad/session/hud/<session>.verdict.json. The High Table found no rule for when that file is missing or cannot be read. This decides whether a broken record can ever stop the session, or whether the chat can close without the record backing it.
